name: Kenya Tech Pulse
about: Fast, checked tech and digital news for Kenya: M-Pesa and money changes, phones and apps, government online services, scam alerts and simple how to guides.
description: Kenya Tech Pulse keeps Kenyans ahead of the changes that touch their phones and their pockets. Every day we bring verified tech news, mobile money and banking updates, new phones and apps, government online services such as KRA, eCitizen and SHA, the latest scams to avoid, and short guides that make digital life simple.
